items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I worked with him once... But he had three gigs for me.

ctx.x: Right. How about Benny Goodman? What was it like to work with him?

I worked with him once and he hated me. He walked into the rehearsal looking at me like I’m looking at you. Looking at the side of my face. I should have right then and there said Benny, thanks, another time. But he had three gigs for me. And I’ve got to preface this by saying that Benny was at times a very odd duck but I’m not calling him on his musicality, don’t misunderstand me. I fully appreciate everything that he did and his worth as a player. And a lot of guys liked him. And they got along with him. They…
